resources.name: 211 Canada
resources.address: Dial 2-1-1 or choose a province in the online directory
resources.summary: Canada's official navigation service for government and community food, housing, health, and social support.
resources.availabilityNote: Channels and hours vary by province, although most of Canada has 24-hour access. This is a referral service.
resources.sourceDetail: The official national page directs people to regional 211 providers and search tools.

resources.name: Health811
resources.accessType: Free 24-hour phone line and online chat
resources.costNote: Free to call or access online
resources.summary: Health811 is a free, secure, and confidential service for people in Ontario to receive health advice from a registered nurse or find health services. It is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week via phone or online chat.
services: Health advice from a registered nurse
Find a doctor or health service
resources.availabilityNote: Available 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Does not replace your other touch point with your health care provider. In a medical emergency call 911 immediately.
resources.sourceKind: Official service locator or guidance page
resources.sourceDetail: The official Health811 page states it is a free, secure and confidential service available 24/7 to get health advice from a registered nurse or find health services.
resources.verifiedQuote: "A free, secure and confidential service you can call or access online 24 hours a day, seven days a week to get health advice from a registered nurse or find health services or information."
resources.coverageNote: Coverage area: Ontario, Canada. The map marker is geographic context, not a single service address.
